title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 3.33 (unsettled) at 20:00 UTC on 5 October 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 10 月 5 日 20:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 3.33（不穩定）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 3.33 (3P) at 20:00 UTC on 5 October 2026. The 20:00 hour is complete (60 samples through 20:59; hour-start 3.33/3P, hour-end 3.67/4M). Last-180 maximum is 3.67 (first at 2026-10-05T20:57:00Z; label 4M). Published-window maximum is 3.67 (first at 2026-10-05T17:59:00Z; label 4M). Window starts 2026-10-05T16:00:00Z (357 samples). Window estimated_kp reached 3.67. The 21:00 UTC hour is incomplete (57 samples through 21:56).

evidence.limitations: Values are estimated Kp at 1-minute cadence and can be revised. The card uses the latest hour that has a full 60 samples; the following hour may still be incomplete.
evidence.method: NOAA SWPC planetary_k_index_1m.json. Main card is the hour-start estimated_kp of the latest complete hour. last-180 and published-window maxima are the first occurrence of the maximum estimated_kp in each window.
